candidates.name: Band Squat
candidates.cardText:
Band Squat
Novice
1
Stand with a shoulder width grip. Both feet should be on the band with the band loops in each of your hand.
2
Push your butt back and also break at the knees.
3
Try to hit parallel depth (bottom of your leg should be parallel with the ground). If you can't tell your squat depth, then try squatting in front of a mirror and watch your form.

candidates.name: Band Romanian Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Band Romanian Deadlift
Novice
1
Stand on your band with both feet.
2
Hinge forward at the hips while keeping a flat back.
3
Hinge until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
4
Push your hips back forward until you are in a standing position.

candidates.name: Band Glute Kickback
candidates.cardText:
Band Glute Kickback
Beginner
1
Get into a quadruped position. Loop the band around both of your wrists and one of your feet.
2
Extend your knee and hip straight back until you feel like contraction in the glutes.
3
Flex at the knee until back in the starting position.

candidates.name: Band Leg Press
candidates.cardText:
Band Leg Press
Advanced
1
Lay flat on the ground with your head by the anchor point of the band, which should be 6 to 12 inches above your head
2
Place the band around your midfoot and extend at the knees and hip.

candidates.name: Band Spanish Squat
candidates.cardText:
Band Spanish Squat
Advanced
1
Anchor a band to a stable point.
2
Place the loops of the band behind your knees.
3
Perform a normal squat and extend your knees against the band at the top.

candidates.name: Band Pullthrough
candidates.cardText:
Band Pullthrough
Beginner
1
Anchor the band to the lowest point possible. Straddle the band and then grab with both hands.
2
Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
3
Push your butt back until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings. Then extend the hips back into the starting position.

candidates.name: Band Hip Abduction
candidates.cardText:
Band Hip Abduction
Beginner
1
Attach the band around your ankle. Stand with feet hip-width apart, feet facing forward, and hands on hips.
2
Lift your right leg away from your body to the side, keeping your knee straight. This is your starting position.
3
Maintaining proper form, move your right leg as far to the side as you can, keeping your left leg planted firmly on the ground. Hold for a second and then return your right leg to the starting position.

candidates.name: Band Hip Adduction
candidates.cardText:
Band Hip Adduction
Intermediate
1
Attach a band to a stable anchor point, such as a door handle or post.
2
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your ankles.
3
Keeping your feet together, move your legs out to the sides and then back to the midline of your body. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

candidates.name: Mini-Band Clamshell
candidates.cardText:
Mini-Band Clamshell
Novice
1
Loop band above knees, lie on side knees bent.
2
Keep feet together, lift top knee upward.
3
Lower slowly without rotating hips backward.

candidates.name: Banded Side Walks
candidates.cardText:
Banded Side Walks
Beginner
1
Place a band either just below or above your knees.
2
Get into a quarter squat position.
3
Step side to side without letting there be any slack in the band to keep tension on the band.

candidates.name: Band Squat Hold Single Arm Row
candidates.cardText:
Band Squat Hold Single Arm Row
Novice
1
Anchor the band to a stable point and take a half squat position.
2
Hold the band loop in one hand and pull your elbow straight back.

candidates.name: Band Squat Hold Row
candidates.cardText:
Band Squat Hold Row
Novice
1
Anchor the band to a stable point.
2
Take a half squat position and hold there.
3
Perform a row while holding the squat position.

candidates.name: Band Goblet Squat
candidates.cardText:
Band Goblet Squat
Novice
1
Stand with a shoulder width grip. Both feet should be on the band with the band looped over both hands.
2
Push your butt back and also break at the knees.
3
Try to hit parallel depth (bottom of your leg should be parallel with the ground). If you can't tell your squat depth, then try squatting in front of a mirror and watch your form.

candidates.name: Band Standing Good Morning
candidates.cardText:
Band Standing Good Morning
Beginner
1
Stand on band and loop it around upper back, feet hip-width apart.
2
Hinge at hips while keeping back flat and slight bend in knees.
3
Squeeze glutes to return to standing, maintaining band tension throughout.

candidates.name: Mini Band Plank Glute Kickback
candidates.cardText:
Mini Band Plank Glute Kickback
Novice
1
Loop band around feet, hold high plank.
2
Extend one leg back, squeezing glute at top.
3
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

candidates.name: Mini Band Plank Step Out
candidates.cardText:
Mini Band Plank Step Out
Novice
1
Loop band around ankles, hold high plank.
2
Step one foot outward, resisting band pull.
3
Return and alternate, maintaining stable hips.

candidates.name: Mini Band Clamshell Raise
candidates.cardText:
Mini Band Clamshell Raise
Novice
1
Loop band above knees, lie on side knees bent.
2
Keep feet together, lift top knee upward, push bottom knee into ground, and push your hips forward.

candidates.name: Mini Band Side Laying Hip Abduction
candidates.cardText:
Mini Band Side Laying Hip Abduction
Novice
1
Loop band above knees, lie on side legs straight.
2
Lift top leg upward without rotating hips.
3
Lower slowly, maintaining constant band tension.

candidates.name: Mini Band Laying Glute Bridge Abduction
candidates.cardText:
Mini Band Laying Glute Bridge Abduction
Novice
1
Loop band above knees, lie on back knees bent.
2
Lift hips into bridge, hold top position.
3
Pulse knees outward against band, controlling tension.

candidates.name: Mini Band Laying Hip Abduction
candidates.cardText:
Mini Band Laying Hip Abduction
Novice
1
Loop band above knees, lie on side legs straight.
2
Lift top leg upward without rotating hips.
3
Lower slowly, keeping tension on band.

candidates.name: Mini Band Glute Bridge
candidates.cardText:
Mini Band Glute Bridge
Novice
1
Loop band above knees, lie on back knees bent.
2
Drive through heels, lift hips until fully extended.
3
Lower slowly, keeping knees pressed outward.

candidates.name: Mini Band Fire Hydrant
candidates.cardText:
Mini Band Fire Hydrant
Novice
1
Loop band above knees, start on hands and knees.
2
Lift one knee outward, keeping hips level.
3
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

candidates.name: Mini Band Jump Squat
candidates.cardText:
Mini Band Jump Squat
Beginner
1
Loop band above knees, stand feet shoulder width.
2
Squat down, knees pushed outward against band.
3
Explode upward into jump, land softly and reset.

candidates.name: Mini Band Single Leg Deadlift
candidates.cardText:
Mini Band Single Leg Deadlift
Beginner
1
Stand on band with one foot, hinge at hips.
2
Keep back flat, opposite leg extended behind.
3
Drive hips forward to return upright.

candidates.name: Mini Band Squat
candidates.cardText:
Mini Band Squat
Novice
1
Loop band above knees, stand shoulder width.
2
Sit back and down, pushing knees outward.
3
Stand up, maintaining tension on band.

candidates.name: Mini Band Side To Side
candidates.cardText:
Mini Band Side To Side
Novice
1
Loop band above knees, slight athletic stance.
2
Step laterally, keeping knees pushed outward.
3
Continue stepping side to side under control.

candidates.name: Mini Band Walking Side To Side
candidates.cardText:
Mini Band Walking Side To Side
Novice
1
Loop band above knees, slight squat stance.
2
Step laterally, keeping constant outward knee pressure.
3
Continue walking side to side under control.

candidates.name: Mini Band Standing Glute Kickback
candidates.cardText:
Mini Band Standing Glute Kickback
Novice
1
Loop band around ankles, stand tall holding support.
2
Extend one leg backward, squeezing glute.
3
Return slowly without arching lower back.

candidates.name: Mini Band Standing Hip Abduction
candidates.cardText:
Mini Band Standing Hip Abduction
Novice
1
Loop band around ankles, stand tall holding support.
2
Lift one leg out to side, torso upright.
3
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.
